question: Choose the correct description: 'My best friend has ______.'
explanation:
📌 Grammar: 'Hair' referring to all hair on head is uncountable, so no article 'a' and no plural 's'. Adjective order: length (short) + color (black) + noun (hair).
💡 OSASCOMP adjective order.
⚠️ Hair is uncountable when describing hairstyle.
